children: Cloud and e-commerce behemoth Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN, Financials) is expanding its government AI service by adding a few competitive model suppliers to AWS GovCloud.

In addition to Amazon's own Nova models, government customers may also access models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Nvidia and xAI via Amazon Bedrock. The investor aspect is wider than the model availability.
Amazon is selling AWS as the infrastructure layer that agencies can choose from among competing artificial intelligence technologies without leaving its cloud environment.
That might help shore up AWS in government computing, where security concerns, compliance norms and procurement complexity can make cloud contracts more sticky.
AWS is already growing fast. Revenue jumped 37% year-over-year in the second quarter while operating income rose 63%.
More model flexibility could help Amazon win more government AI workloads without using its own models to win every use case.
The strategy also gives AWS access to demand linked to some of the largest names in artificial intelligence even if customers choose non-Amazon models.
The next test is whether more GovCloud adoption results in quicker public-sector growth and a larger contribution to AWS revenue.

title: Amazon Just Put OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta Inside GovCloud
